notes:
A piano and guitar practice app for Android.

Sheet music and falling notes, a fingering worked out for scores that do not carry one, and hands that play along on the keyboard and on the guitar neck. It listens to a MIDI keyboard over USB or Bluetooth, and can send the song to a MIDI piano so the piano plays it instead of the phone.

New in 0.58: MIDI files open. Import a .mid and it becomes a playable score -- hands, staves and fingering worked out from it, tempo changes and all. Which hand plays what is taken from the file's tracks where it separates them, and guessed from pitch where it does not; a MIDI file does not record it.

Sixty-six public-domain scores are included -- Bach, Beethoven, Chopin, Mozart, Debussy, Satie, Joplin, Schubert, Liszt, Brahms and others. You can import your own MusicXML (.musicxml, .xml or .mxl), MIDI (.mid) and PDF sheet music as well.

This is a test build and updates itself: check for updates under Settings.
